description: This file defines the enum 'EmailCampaignStatus', representing various statuses (INVALID, PENDING, ACTIVE, CLOSED) for email campaigns within the system. It includes methods to convert integer values to enum instances, access status properties, and check the current status.

classes.name: EmailCampaignStatus
classes.description: An enum representing different states of an email campaign, with associated integer values and string codes. Includes utility methods for status conversion and checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to the corresponding EmailCampaignStatus enum constant.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing the status.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the current status is ACTIVE.

methods.name: isPending
methods.description: Checks if the current status is PENDING.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the current status is CLOSED.
